changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT SCHEMA_ID FROM sys.schemas WHERE [name] = 'graph') BEGIN exec sp_executesql N'CREATE SCHEMA graph AUTHORIZATION dbo' END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT SCHEMA_ID FROM sys.schemas WHERE [name] = 'graph') BEGIN DROP SCHEMA graph END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'graph' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetNode') begin CREATE TABLE graph.AssetNode ( ID bigint not null, [Uid] uniqueidentifier not null, AssetTypeID int not null, AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier not null, Properties xml null, [Path] nvarchar(2500) null, [Segments] xml null, [State] int not null, [UpdatedOn] datetime not null, INDEX IX_GraphAssetNode_Id UNIQUE ($node_id) ) AS NODE
CREATE INDEX IX_GraphAssetNode ON graph.AssetNode ( UpdatedOn ) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'graph' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetEdge') begin CREATE TABLE graph.[AssetEdge] ( ID bigint not null, [Uid] uniqueidentifier not null, IntersectTypeID int not null, [IntersectTypeUid] uniqueidentifier not null, PredicateID int not null, PredicateUid uniqueidentifier not null, PredicateType int not null, Properties xml not null, [State] int not null, [UpdatedOn] datetime not null, CONSTRAINT EC_GraphAssetEdge CONNECTION (graph.AssetNode TO graph.AssetNode), INDEX IX_GraphAssetEdge_Id UNIQUE ($edge_id), INDEX IX_GraphAssetEdge_From ($from_id, $to_id), INDEX IX_GraphAssetEdge_To ($to_id, $from_id) ) AS EDGE
CREATE INDEX IX_GraphAssetEdge ON graph.AssetEdge ( UpdatedOn ) end
